method: Custom photon Monte Carlo (3e6 source photons, 10x10 pyramid at SSD 100 cm, XCOM interactions, Klein-Nishina/Rayleigh/pair kernels) with next-event scoring to a 7-point average over the 1 cm-radius cylinder at depths 0.25–5 cm; primary fluence analytic (exp(-mu*d) with inverse-square to 105 cm); interaction and energy-transfer fractions from fluence x mu_i(E); electron source spectra from Klein-Nishina kinematics; electron fluence from CSDA slowing-down with Moller knock-on production (ESTAR stopping powers); K = Phi*E*mu_tr, K_col = K(1-g) with g from ESTAR yields, D = K_col (beta = 1, CPE); Spencer-Attix water/air with Delta = 10 keV via restricted Moller losses and Bethe scaling for air, plus track-end term; PDD from K_col depth profile convolved with an electron kernel (lambda = 0.09 cm) giving d_max ≈ 0.5 cm. Approximations: L4 angular uses initial-direction distribution; photoelectric/pair electron directions taken as photon direction; air data not in provided files.
data_sources: XCOM-style water photon coefficients (/tmp/data/xcom_water.txt: coherent, incoherent, photoelectric, pair, total with coherent) for all attenuation and interaction rates; ESTAR-style water electron stopping powers, CSDA ranges, radiation yields and density-effect data (/tmp/data/estar_water.txt); analytic Klein-Nishina and Moller cross sections; air stopping-power ratio scaled from water using Bethe formula with I_air = 85.7 eV and Z/A = 0.49919 (air table not provided).
